correctness.rationale: For n>=2 the graph is defined by two independent G_(n-1) copies and an independent uniform perfect matching. Every four-cycle lies in one child or crosses in exactly two matching edges; crossings biject to edge overlap under the matching. For two arbitrary d-regular simple graphs on m vertices, edge-pair collision enumeration yields E[X]=md^2/[2(m-1)] and Var(X)=md^2(m-d-1)^2/[2(m-3)(m-1)^2], with the m=2 case separately deterministic. Independent exact symbolic rational expansion of the ordered adjacent/disjoint edge-pair probabilities verifies this nonstandard variance formula. Constant conditional moments give E C_n=Σ 2^(n-k)a_k and Var C_n=Σ 2^(n-k)b_k. Sum b_k/2^k finite and positive, so the iid depth-L block CLT and L2-small orthogonal upper-level remainder prove the Gaussian limit as L→∞; summable Chebyshev bounds prove almost sure LLN for any coupling. For every n-regular simple graph tr(A^4)=2^n(2n²-n)+8C_n. Independent high-precision summation checked λ and σ², and source verifier implements exact n=3/n=4 matching-overlap enumeration. These finite computations corroborate the universal algebraic proof.
